title: Flaunt Recalls Magsafe Battery Chargers Due to Risk of Serious Injury or Death from Fire and Burn Hazards
description: This recall involves the Flaunt MagSafe Battery Charger power banks with model number E33A. "FLAUNT" is engraved on the front right side of the power bank and there is a small circular button in the bottom center of the front side of the power bank. The back label of the unit is marked "FLAUNT" and "Model: E33A". The power banks were sold in melon, black, lavender and white. The chargers measure 3 by 2 by 0.25 inches and weigh around 3.2 ounces.
injuries: The firm has received five reports of the power banks overheating and catching fire, including one report of a burn to a consumer's hand, one report of a burn to a consumer's arm and four reports of minor property damage.
